summary: 澳大利亚飞行医疗服务把牙医送到偏远社区。交通不便、飞机载重和复诊间隔限制了可提供的服务，因此团队既要应付多种口腔问题，也要通过清洁教育和防护用品帮助居民预防疾病。
logic: 慢性病和日常用品短缺

paragraphs.brief: 皇家飞行医疗进入偏远社区
sentences: Australians living or travelling in rural and remote areas can face particular difficulties when they need medical care.
在澳大利亚乡村或偏远地区生活、旅行的人，需要就医时可能遇到特殊困难。
Hundreds of kilometres from major cities and many hours by road from the closest hospital or clinic, some rural Australians do not have easy access to doctors, nurses and dentists.
有些乡村居民离大城市数百公里，去最近的医院或诊所也要开车好几个小时，很难及时见到医生、护士或牙医。
Organisations such as the Royal Flying Doctor Service (RFDS) have been established to bring health services to outback Australian communities.
皇家飞行医疗服务组织（RFDS）等机构应运而生，将医疗服务带入澳大利亚内陆偏远社区。
The RFDS provides free medical care to people who live, work or travel in remote and regional parts of Australia.
该组织为在澳大利亚偏远地区和地方城镇居住、工作或旅行的人免费提供医疗服务。

This non-profit organisation is the oldest and largest airborne health service of its kind in the world, and since 1928 it has used small aircraft to send doctors and nurses to some of Australia’s most far-away communities.
这个非营利组织是世界上最古老、规模最大的此类空中保健服务机构，自1928年以来，它利用小型飞机向澳大利亚一些最偏远的社区派遣医生和护士。
paragraphs.gist: 澳大利亚内陆居民和旅客可能离医院数百公里，皇家飞行医生服务自1928年起便用小型飞机将免费医疗送到偏远社区。

paragraphs.brief: 巡回牙科服务面临的难题
sentences: In recent years, the RFDS has also started to fly dentists to regional Australia.
近年来，皇家飞行医疗服务组织也开始用飞机把牙医送往澳大利亚各地方社区。
As well as offering mobile dental clinics, the RFDS offers a range of preventative and educational services.
除了提供流动牙科诊所外，RFDS还提供一系列预防和教育服务。
Looking after the teeth of people in remote areas presents special challenges.
照顾边远地区人民的牙齿是特殊的挑战。
These include providing care to disparate communities with no established dental facilities, and dealing with higher incidences of other diseases which are linked to, or caused by poor dental health.
难点包括为分散且没有固定牙科设施的社区看诊，以及应对当地发病率较高、与牙齿健康不佳有关或由其引发的其他疾病。
paragraphs.gist: 飞行医疗队后来增加牙科巡诊、预防和教育，既要面对社区分散、设备不足，也要处理与口腔健康相关的其他疾病。

paragraphs.brief: 巡诊间隔长带来的影响
sentences: People in remote areas have very infrequent visits by health staff.
偏远地区很少有医护人员来访。
RFDS dentists might only visit a community once every few months, or sometimes once per year.
RFDS牙医只能每几个月访问一个社区一次，有时每年访问一次。
Because of infrequent dentist visits, patients in these areas often need to put up with their dental problems before they can get treatment.
由于牙医不经常探访，这些地区的病人在获得治疗之前往往需要忍受他们的牙科问题。
Consequently, people in remote areas are more likely to have tooth decay (the blackening and deterioration of teeth) and develop gum and other mouth diseases.
因此，偏远地区居民更容易发生龋齿（牙齿变黑、受损），也更容易患牙龈疾病和其他口腔疾病。
paragraphs.gist: 有的社区几个月甚至一年才迎来一次牙医，居民只能推迟治疗，因此更容易发生龋齿以及牙龈和其他口腔疾病。

paragraphs.brief: 小型飞机的设备载运限制
sentences: In some locations that the RFDS visits, there are no suitable dental facilities, so dentists have to bring everything with them.
在某些地区，RFDS探访时，没有合适的牙科设施，因此牙医必须携带所有物品。
This includes drills, dentists’ chairs, portable X-ray machines, and computers for keeping track of patients’ treatments.
这些设备包括牙钻、牙科诊疗椅、便携式X光机，以及记录患者诊疗情况的电脑。
Equipment can weigh up to 100 kilograms, and since the small planes that transport dentists have limited space, dentists cannot always bring everything that they need.
设备重量可达100公斤，而且由于运输牙医的小型飞机空间有限，牙医不能总是携带他们需要的一切。
paragraphs.gist: 无牙科设施的地点连牙椅和便携X光机都需随行，器材总重可达一百公斤，小型飞机空间有限，牙医未必能带齐所需物品。

paragraphs.brief: 全科牙医与假牙服务的困难
sentences: While dentists in town or city centres can specialise in certain types of treatment, RFDS dentists need to be ‘all-rounders’.
城镇中心的牙医可以专攻某些治疗，而飞行牙医必须是样样都能做的多面手。
They need to be able to do all kinds of dental procedures, as they don’t have the ability to refer patients to more specialised dentists.
他们得能处理各种牙科诊疗，因为不具备把患者转诊给更专科牙医的条件。
Even with their broad experience, there are some services that are particularly challenging for RFDS dentists.
即使他们具有广泛的经验，一些服务对RFDS牙医来说也特别具有挑战性。
For example, dentures (or artificial teeth) can be very difficult to provide, as they need to be the right shape and size for the patient, and this requires many visits over a long period of time.
例如，假牙(或人工牙)可能很难提供，因为它们必须是病人的正确形状和大小，这需要长时间多次检查。
As a result, it is not practical to make dentures available.
因此，提供假牙是不切实际的。
paragraphs.gist: 无法轻易转诊使飞行牙医必须掌握多种治疗，但制作假牙需长期多次调整尺寸和形状，在偏远地区仍难常规提供。

paragraphs.brief: 慢性病增添口腔健康风险
sentences: Some chronic illnesses are more common in remote communities than in the rest of Australia.
一些慢性病在偏远社区比在澳大利亚其他地区更为常见。
These illnesses can in turn lead to a lowered resistance to infection, including gum and other oral infections.
这些慢性病也可能降低身体对感染的抵抗力，包括对牙龈及其他口腔感染的抵抗力。

As a result, people in outback Australian communities are more likely to experience oral health problems than city folk, and this poses extra challenges for both the dentists and the doctors of the RFDS.
因此，与城市居民相比，澳大利亚内陆偏远社区的居民更容易出现口腔健康问题，这给飞行医疗服务的牙医和医生都增加了困难。
paragraphs.gist: 内陆社区一些较常见的慢性病会降低抵抗感染的能力，牙龈及其他口腔感染风险因而上升，也加重了医疗队的工作难度。

paragraphs.brief: 保健知识和用品的获取
sentences: Because there aren’t a lot of dental services in remote areas, people living in these areas also receive less education about good dental hygiene than their city counterparts do.
因为偏远地区没有太多的牙科服务，生活在这些地区的人们也比城市的同行得到的关于良好牙科卫生的教育更少。
Australians in very remote communities might not be aware of things that people in cities take for granted, such as the importance of daily tooth brushing.
在非常偏远的社区里，澳大利亚人可能不知道城市里人们认为理所当然的事情，例如每天刷牙的重要性。
Also, basic dental hygiene items such as toothpaste and toothbrushes can be more expensive in outback areas.
牙膏、牙刷等基本口腔清洁用品在内陆偏远地区也可能更贵。
Many people are on low incomes, meaning they have extra difficulty affording these products.
许多人收入很低，这意味着他们要购买这些产品要困难得多。
If this is the case, the RFDS supplies these.
如果是这种情况，RFDS提供这些物品。
paragraphs.gist: 偏远地区的口腔保健教育较少，牙膏牙刷又可能价高，医疗队会为负担不起这些用品的居民提供帮助。

sentences: As well as treating patients, RFDS dentists try to focus on preventative oral health and educate their patients on good oral hygiene, such as tooth brushing and flossing.
飞行牙医除了看诊，也重视预防，会教患者如何刷牙、使用牙线等口腔护理方法。
The RFDS also provides mouthguards for young sports players.
飞行医疗服务还为年轻运动员提供运动护齿。
Playing contact sports, such as rugby league or Australian rules football, can damage young people’s teeth, so mouthguards provide protection which prevents accidental injuries.
联盟式橄榄球、澳式足球等身体接触较多的运动可能伤及牙齿，佩戴运动护齿可以预防意外损伤。
paragraphs.gist: 除了治疗，飞行牙医还教刷牙、使用牙线，并向参加橄榄球等有身体接触项目的年轻人提供护齿套来预防意外损伤。

paragraphs.brief: 偏远地区的饮水与防龋
sentences: Adding fluoride to water supplies has been proven to reduce the incidence of tooth decay in many parts of the world.
在世界许多地方，向饮用水中添加氟化物已被证实能降低龋齿发生率。
City dwellers in Australia use water supplies that have been fluoridated, and their rates of tooth decay are lower because of this.
澳大利亚城市居民使用加氟的自来水，因此龋齿发生率较低。
In remote areas, it is not practical to fluoridate drinking water supplies, and so people living in these areas are more subject to tooth decay.
偏远地区难以给饮用水加氟，因此当地居民更容易患龋齿。
As a result, it is particularly important that people living in areas without fluoridated water pay special attention to regular brushing of their teeth with fluoridated toothpaste.
因此，在没有加氟饮用水的地区，居民尤其需要注意定期使用含氟牙膏刷牙。
paragraphs.gist: 文章比较城市与偏远地区的供水，指出后者难以普遍实行饮水加氟，因此当地居民用含氟牙膏定期刷牙尤其重要。

sentences: Despite many challenges, the RFDS continues to offer much needed dental and medical support.
尽管困难重重，皇家飞行医疗服务组织仍持续提供当地迫切需要的牙科及其他医疗服务。
Its presence in isolated communities greatly improves the quality of dental health, and supports important oral hygiene and health initiatives.
它深入偏远社区，大大改善了当地的牙齿健康状况，也支持了重要的口腔卫生和保健项目。
paragraphs.gist: 尽管巡诊困难，飞行医疗队仍使孤立社区获得迫切需要的牙科与医疗支持，并推动日常口腔卫生和健康计划。

items.en: Many of the RFDS doctors work as volunteers.
items.zh: 皇家飞行医生服务的许多医生以志愿者身份工作。
items.why: 飞行医生服务是非营利机构，文中没有说明其中多少医生无偿工作。

items.en: RFDS dentists make trips to outback communities each month.
items.zh: 皇家飞行医生服务的牙医每月都会去内陆社区巡诊。
items.why: 题干“each month = 每月一次”是频繁、固定。原文“once every few months / once per year” 强调非常不频繁，含义相反，故 FALSE。

items.en: RFDS dentists are accompanied on their journeys to remote areas by a dental nurse.
items.zh: 牙医去偏远地区巡诊时，有一名牙科护士同行。
items.why: 飞机送医生和护士前往偏远社区，但文中没有说每次牙医出诊都有牙科护士同行。

items.en: RFDS dentists must provide a wide range of dental services.
items.zh: RFDS牙医必须提供广泛的牙科服务。
items.why: 市区牙医可以专攻某些治疗，而飞行牙医必须是“多面手”，即承担多种诊疗工作。

items.en: Rural dental patients are more informed about oral hygiene than urban patients.
items.zh: 农村牙科病人比城市病人更了解口腔卫生。
items.why: 题干说“more informed (更了解)”,原文是“receive less education”,方向相反，答案 FALSE。

items.en: RFDS dentists educate patients about good eating habits.
items.zh: RFDS牙医对病人进行良好的饮食习惯教育。
items.why: 原文只谈“oral hygiene (口腔卫生)”,举例刷牙、用牙线，没有任何“diet / eating habits” 的内容，因此对饮食习惯是 NOT GIVEN。

items.en: Urban Australians generally have better teeth because their water is treated.
items.zh: 澳大利亚城市居民使用经过处理的水，因此牙齿通常更健康。
items.why: “water…fluoridated” = 水被处理。“rates of tooth decay are lower” = 牙齿更好。且有“because of this”表因果，与题干一致，所以是TRUE。

items.en: need to bring equipment including ________ for records
items.zh: 出诊时必须携带设备，其中包括用来保存诊疗记录的________。
items.why: “for records”= 为了记录，原文中负责记录的是 computers,且紧跟“for keeping track of patients’ treatments”,语义完全对应，因此填 computers。

items.en: aircraft used to carry equipment have restricted ________
items.zh: 用于运输设备的飞机上，________有限。
items.why: 题干“restricted 9 ”与原文“limited space”同义,restricted = limited,所以答案是 space。

items.en: problems offering some services, e.g. fitting ________
items.zh: 有些服务很难提供，例如为病人装配________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“例如，假牙(或人工牙)可能很难提供，因为它们必须是病人的正确形状和大小，这需要长时间多次检查”，再按题干要求写出答案。
回到对应内容“牙膏、牙刷等基本口腔清洁用品在内陆偏远地区也可能更贵”，再按题干要求写出答案。
与 11 搭配的第二个用品即 toothbrushes,注意要用复数形式。

items.en: ________ to limit dental accidents on the sports field
items.zh: 牙医还提供________，帮助减少体育运动中的牙齿意外损伤。
items.why: 笔记“limit dental accidents on the sports field” 与原文“prevent accidental injuries” 同义，能够在运动场上减少牙齿受伤的就是 mouthguards。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: provide a wide range of dental services
do all kinds of dental procedures
for keeping track of patients’ treatments
points: 原文只谈“oral hygiene (口腔卫生)”,举例刷牙、用牙线，没有任何“diet / eating habits” 的内容，因此对饮食习惯是 NOT GIVEN。
回到对应内容“牙膏、牙刷等基本口腔清洁用品在内陆偏远地区也可能更贵”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: …, so dentists have to bring everything with them.
“In some locations that the RFDS visits, there are no suitable dental facilities”补足 have 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 have 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
连接词 while 引出“While dentists in town or city centres can specialise in certain types of treatment”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
